MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Man Who Kills Troubles, The
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and he wants to take care of them for her. His girlfriend was Chloe and she died in a lab explosion that has been concluded as an accident. In Hong Kong, K becomes O Sir, a Physical Education teacher. His students include Ko Chun, Chloe's younger brother. He also chooses to live next door to the Ko family. 2 years later, Jovy turns up at the school as a music teacher and she is partnered with O Sir to handle Ko Chun's class. Together, they help their students with their problems including run-ins with triad members. Jovy reminds O Sir of Chloe as they share many similarities while Jovy herself starts to develop feelings for O Sir. Due to Jovy's family background which exposes her to danger, O Sir has to secretly step in to save her. But how long can O Sir keep his identity a secret? He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.title: Handmaidens United
programme.desc: Yuet-ying (Jacqueline Wong) is a maid in the Vice Minister of War Kau Residence. She is also the leader of six groups of maids, who have formed an intelligence sharing alliance to make money. Yuet-gau (Roxanne Tong) has sold herself and become a maid as she is raising money for her beloved Fu Yau-wai (Brian Tse) to go to the capital to take the imperial exam. Yuet-ying and Yuet-gau are taking care of Madam Koon Chi-pui (Florence Kwok) and Madam Sheungkoon Wan-ying (Angie Cheong) respectively. The duo keep trying to outwit each other for the sake of their bosses. Kau Kei-tsun (Tony Hung), aka Young Master, and Yuet-ying become lovers. Regrettably, Kei-tsun's father Kau Ching (Timothy Cheng) makes Kei-tsun's life difficult. Kau Ching is demoted as he has committed some offense. Kei-tsun diligently prepares to tackle the imperial exam as he wants to restore family honor. Fok Yin-jing (Lisa Lau), the daughter of Minister of War Fok Bun (Poon Chi Man), also fancies Yau-wai and repeatedly seduces him. Yuet-ying and Yuet-gau are determined to jeopardize their lovers' study efforts as they are afraid of being ditched if their guys pass the imperial exam with flying colors. While both couples are about to break up, they are abruptly drawn into a coup conspiracy.

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: Man Who Kills Troubles, The
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and he wants to take care of them for her. His girlfriend was Chloe and she died in a lab explosion that has been concluded as an accident. In Hong Kong, K becomes O Sir, a Physical Education teacher. His students include Ko Chun, Chloe's younger brother. He also chooses to live next door to the Ko family. 2 years later, Jovy turns up at the school as a music teacher and she is partnered with O Sir to handle Ko Chun's class. Together, they help their students with their problems including run-ins with triad members. Jovy reminds O Sir of Chloe as they share many similarities while Jovy herself starts to develop feelings for O Sir. Due to Jovy's family background which exposes her to danger, O Sir has to secretly step in to save her. But how long can O Sir keep his identity a secret? He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.desc: In 1939, during the harsh anti-Japanese war in the Taihang Mountains, Eighth Route Army soldiers were unable to care for their newborn children due to brutal battlefield conditions. Facing constant enemy threats, these women forged a deep bond with the military through incredible sacrifice and bravery.

programme.title: New Taiwan Is Online
programme.desc: In a media landscape flooded with misinformation, this current affairs programme cuts through the noise with sharp analysis and investigative reporting. Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect 'partners', Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways…

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: Set in Northern China in 1932, inmate Fu Yuan escapes from prison by digging a tunnel with a silver spoon. Inspector Song Dong Lu is assigned to investigate the case. Following letters sent by Fu, Song travels to Hong City to uncover the mystery behind her disappearance, facing deeper conspiracies along the way.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: YUM is a detective agency that handles supernatural cases. As YUM investigates the evil spirits appearing in an old building, they discover that the spirits are created by a spirit master to haunt the residents so that the building can be vacated for redevelopment. Can the YUM investigators finally find ways to fight against the master?

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price…

programme.title: Cold War 2
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Lau's wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation.

programme.title: Measure in Love
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate.

programme.title: Victim(s)
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victim's mother and the murderer's mother as they uncover their sons' hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth.

programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive, complex world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and top-secret sting operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Ready O/r Rot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi are finally getting married but pressure from Guy's mother creates much friction between them. Meanwhile, Grey Bear suspects his wife of cheating on him and Ken faces the biggest crisis of his life when Jessica accidentally gets pregnant. Can they eventually solve their relationship problems?

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural “Bloody Parrot”. Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels. Featuring two of the leading action stars of the era, Chen Kuen-tai and Lo Lieh, in a series of intense poker game standoffs. Famed director of the genre, Wong Jing, also has a guest appearance as one of the Notorious Eight.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nu's elder sister hopes to restore the clan's honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Finger Of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous “Finger of Doom”, a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clan's hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary "Ri Hou". Instead, he finds "Ri Hou" dead and discovers the clan's founder, "Ye Di" Tie Yi, is his real father.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Game Changer
programme.desc: Ram Nandan, a government official, embarks on a relentless fight against corrupt politicians. Determined to bring about fair elections, he tries to revolutionise the way the government operates.

programme.title: Ghosty
programme.desc: Police officer, pursuing outlaw who escaped her father's custody 20 years ago, accidentally shoots someone else in a failed shootout.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Kedi Billa Killadi Ranga
programme.desc: Kesavan and Murugan are friends who aim to make it big in politics by trying to impress people with their weird tricks. They pay no heed to others' advice and are rejected by their love interests.

programme.title: Periya Manushan
programme.desc: A wealthy elderly man caught in a love triangle with his two wives changes his behavior after a life-changing event, leading to family complications.

programme.title: Pyaar Prema Kaadhal
programme.desc: Sree Kumar, a young man, falls in love with Sindhuja, a vivacious woman. However, complications soon arise and they part their separate ways only to reunite again.

programme.title: Kaaval
programme.desc: Thamban and Antony were best friends and business partners. A family tragedy and its falling-out separates them for good.

programme.title: Shivanagam
programme.desc: Naganika's family is in charge of an ancient monument that Kapali has his eyes set on. When Kapali kills her to seek the monument, Naganika is reborn as a snake in her next life to seek revenge.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: When a skull is found in a package, ACP Sathyajith is assigned to identify the victim and catch the killer. Meanwhile, a journalist haunted by a spirit investigates the mystery.

programme.title: Kalki 2898 Ad
programme.desc: The future of those in the dystopian city of Kasi is altered when the destined arrival of Lord Vishnu's final avatar launches a war against darkness.

programme.title: Honey Bunny In Planet Of The Pigaliens
programme.desc: Honey and Bunny embark on various unplanned adventures as they visit a strange planet and try to thwart the evil Pigalia.

Dalam masa sama, Damia berdepan kemarahan DS Johari kerana hubungannya dengan Johan, sebelum sebuah kejutan besar terungkai apabila Damia disahkan hamil empat bulan.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Ana panik kerana menyebabkan ikan Taufik, Oscar mati secara tidak sengaja semasa mencuci akuarium dan Nani menggantikannya dengan ikan baru yang berjenis sama untuk membantu Ana. Taufik tidak dapat terima perubahan cara hidup Dato' Ishmael dan mengajak Johan bertaruh untuk membuktikan duit boleh membeli kebahagiaan dan cinta apabila Johan mempertahankan tindakan bapanya. Ana gusar mengapa Taufik mengarahkan dia ke pejabat pada keesokan harinya setelah tahu kematian Oscar.

Keikhlasan Angga diuji apabila Ratih meletakkan syarat patuh agama sebelum menerima cintanya, manakala kehadiran Arya yang sempurna menambah konflik.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong

Dengan bantuan Imran, abangnya, Ira pergi ke pejabat Reez. Di pejabat, sepupu Reez, Fariz, memberitahu Ira yang Reez telah berkahwin dan kini sedang berbulan madu! Ira terperanjat. Ira akhirnya setuju untuk berkahwin dengan Hans untuk membalas dendam terhadap Reez. Marlia tetap tidak setuju. Kamal, kawan baik Hans juga tidak setuju.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Ira menangis dan merayu kepada Rashid agar tidak menerima Hans sebagai suaminya. Rashid beri tempuh 48 jam untuk Ira mencari dan menghubungi Reez. Dengan bantuan Imran, abangnya, Ira pergi ke pejabat Reez. Di pejabat, sepupu Reez, Fariz, memberitahu Ira yang Reez telah berkahwin dan kini sedang berbulan madu! Ira terperanjat. Ira akhirnya setuju untuk berkahwin dengan Hans untuk membalas dendam terhadap Reez. Marlia tetap tidak setuju. Kamal, kawan baik Hans juga tidak setuju.

programme.title: Satu, Dua…Dia?
programme.desc: Ketegangan mencapai kemuncak, rahsia besar akhirnya terbongkar, dan pilihan Mia semakin sukar.

programme.title: Ronda Roda
programme.desc: Episod 5 membawakan kelainan bersama Panjang Lambretta dalam segmen Gegar Garage, reviu jentera elektrik Porsche Taycan (Review Kereta), dan lawatan ke tumpuan komuniti permotoran tempatan di Rider Garage (Usha Kedai).

programme.title: Aroma Masak
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Daging Cincang Cili Padi Kicap & Bubur Jagung sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Mal Kamal.

programme.title: Ekspresi Fesyen
programme.desc: Ekspresi Fesyen minggu ini host Aqilah Azali akan berbual fesyen bersama Diana dari butik The Labels. Akan berkenalan dengan pereka baru Kissah dan juga kita akan disajikan dengan fesyen dari artis tempatan.

programme.title: K-Love
programme.desc: K-kru pergi ke perjumpaan peminat selebriti yang popular dan bersaing untuk mendapatkan tiket emas. Tish mendapati Raffy ada teman wanita baharu, Fran dan Val menghasilkan cara berbeza untuk masuk ke dalam khemah VIP dan Jay membincangkan harta pusaka keluarga Val.

programme.title: Satu, Dua…Dia?
programme.desc: Episod Akhir: Mia memilih jalan hidupnya, Isa dan Jay menerima keputusan, dan kisah mereka berakhir dengan penebusan dan harapan baharu.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Airel enggan menerima kehamilan Damia dan meragui status anak itu, menyebabkan konflik mereka semakin memuncak. Dalam masa sama, Sara dan Irfan semakin bahagia, malah Irfan membantu merapatkan hubungan Sara dengan Hussin. Namun, ketika mereka kembali menikmati kebahagiaan, Irfan dikejutkan dengan berita mengejutkan daripada Tokma mengenai Fatimah yang selama ini berkelakuan pelik.

programme.title: Pendosa Ingin Ke Syurga
programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn (Abdullah) menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Rajawali
programme.desc: “Rajawali” mengisahkan penggodam yang diupah Komang untuk memecah sistem komputer ciptaan Arwin, namun program itu merupakan ritual ilmu hitam digital. Arwin dirasuk oleh program tersebut, manakala Komang terjerumus ke kegelapan.

programme.title: The Hidden Hand (Dia Perempuan Sialan) EP2
programme.desc: Riska pulih dan mula menjalankan tugasnya dengan pantas memenangi hati Nerina dan Syawal. Namun, semasa mengemas bilik Puan Sri yang telah lama ditinggalkan, Riska menemui peninggalan keluarga yang menyimpan kenangan perit.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP2
programme.desc: Perantara Siaful Azmi berkongsi pengalaman mengenai kisah penggali kubur di Pantai Dalam, Kuala Lumpur. Pekerjaan menggali kubur merupakan pekerjaan sambilan yang dilakukan secara tradisional. Perantara berjumpa dengan penggali kubur di sana, En. Jamian Man, En Ishak Hamilan dan Yussman Nordin yang berkongsi pengalaman bertemu dengan lembaga misteri dan kejadian menakutkan saperti berjumpa dengan lelaki berjubah putih, sekumpulan lembaga dan bunyi yang menakutkan. Perantara kemudiannya berada di kawasan tersebut bersama krew, mereka terdengar bungi menyeramkan, azan dan menjawab salam diberi.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK), kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato' Hashim. Ketika Dato' Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.

programme.title: Munafik
programme.desc: Adam merupakan seorang pengamal perubatan Islam yang tidak dapat menerima hakikat isterinya sudah tiada di dunia ini. Kemudian, dia bersetuju untuk merawat seorang wanita yang tertekan bernama Maria tetapi perkara aneh dan meresahkan mula berlaku.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Don't Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama (AMTA) bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP6
programme.desc: Madam Kwan teringat kembali kisah sebenar. Vince, anaknya, ialah pedofil yang menculik Kasyorga dan Hamdi. Uncle Lim

programme.title: Bonnie
programme.desc: Bonnie, seorang remaja sekolah menengah, mempunyai masa lalu yang kelam. Walau bagaimanapun, berbekalkan kemahiran seni mempertahankan diri, dia mampu bertahan untuk melindungi dirinya malah orang-orangnya.

programme.title: Siccin 7
programme.desc: Terpaksa meninggalkan kerjayanya sebagai doktor dan melarikan diri akibat satu 'perjanjian berdarah' dengan sindiket mafia yang mengeksploitasi kanak-kanak pengemis, Kemal berpindah bersama keluarganya ke rumah agam milik bapa saudaranya.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP5
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ariani, seorang model tudung terkenal yang terlalu takut kehilangan kecantikan, populariti dan tempatnya dalam industri. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: The Hidden Hand (Dia Perempuan Sialan) EP3
programme.desc: Syawal memarahi Riska susulan satu insiden yang melibatkan Nerina tanpa menyedari sifat sebenar Riska. Sementara Afidah berjuang mempertahankan peninggalan mendiang suaminya, kenangan kelam mengenai kekejaman Puan Sri pada masa lalu kembali muncul.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP3
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di Galaeri Perfileman yang ditubuhkan pada 2007 terletak di KL. Asalnya bangunan banglo tersebut adalah sebuah rumah keluarga. Galeri ini menyimpan peralatanperalatan lama perfileman untuk dipamerkan. Pengalaman misteri yang pernah dilalui oleh Encik Muhammad Rosli, penjaga galeri dikongsi bersama, beliau pernah beberapa kali terjumpa dengan lembaga wanita berambut panjang, pergerakan perkakasan dan bunyi yang menakutkan. Pengantara bersama krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan, mereka berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi yang hampir sama saperti diceritakan.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: Dunia Kiara

Kehidupannya berubah menjadi penuh cabaran apabila dia cuba membantu roh-roh yang mempunyai urusan yang tidak selesai di dunia. Di tengah konflik misteri tersebut, Kiara juga harus mengemudi kisah cinta dan persahabatan di sekolahnya yang semakin rumit.

Suatu hari, dia menemui sebuah mesin taip ajaib yang membolehkannya menulis semula hidupnya dan memasuki dunia alternatif. programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

Atas cadangan rakannya, dia mengambil isteri kedua, Yati, lalu tercetus pelbagai konflik dan situasi lucu yang menguji rumah tangga mereka.

programme.title: Longkai
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang geng 'longkai' (tonto atau penunda kereta). Eddie dan Bada ialah adik-beradik longkai yang terkenal. Semua kenderaan yang ditunda oleh mereka akan dibawa ke bengkel Rimau. Walaupun dia seorang wanita, Rimau berperwatakan sedikit tomboy dan lasak. Rimau telah jatuh cinta dengan Bada, tetapi dia tidak pernah berani untuk meluahkan perasaannya walaupun dia nampak 'tough'.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Love Supermoon

Mereka hanya mengenali antara satu sama lain melalui gosip yang didengar, namun berpura-pura tidak mengenali setiap kali bertemu.

programme.title: Cucu Atok
programme.desc: Pak Zubir menjaga cucunya, Aiman yang menjadi yatim piatu apabila kedua ibu bapanya meninggal dunia akibat kemalangan. Bapa Aiman seorang usahawan berjaya dan telah mewasiatkan harta yang banyak kepada Aiman. Pak Ngah dan Mak Ngahnya berniat jahat untuk membolot harta tersebut. Niat mereka didorong apabila Juwita meminjam wang daripada Ah Long dan gagal melunaskan pinjaman.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: Adik Kakak
programme.desc: Mengisahkan pengorbanan Hanum (45 tahun) yang menjaga kakaknya, Azizah (52 tahun) yang mempunyai masalah ketidakupayaan intelektual (Intellectual Disorder) peringkat sederhana.

programme.title: The Real Sister

Namun semuanya berubah selepas satu insiden ketika menerima rawatan di hospital menyebabkan Mastura dijangkiti HIV secara tidak sengaja, lalu hidupnya berubah dari disenangi menjadi dibenci masyarakat kampung

programme.title: Tentang Dia

Kehidupannya berubah selepas bertemu Rudi, seorang gadis yang membantunya kembali menikmati hidup. Pada masa yang sama, Randu yang mencintai Gadis terus berusaha mendapatkan hatinya, sehingga Gadis perlu berdepan dengan perasaan, kehilangan dan makna sebenar sebuah hubungan.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps & What's On Today
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER) and KOT KWOK KWONG (CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY) have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. Everything is in harmony until KWONG's father discovers MAN and KWONG's pre-marriage written agreement. Their relationship complicates ever since. To make things worse, KWONG breaks the agreement and demands to have his own career. MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG (WANG CHIEH, DAVE), who is now MAN's colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel & What's On Today
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Mystic Nine & What's On Today
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Man Who Kills Troubles, The
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and he wants to take care of them for her. His girlfriend was Chloe and she died in a lab explosion that has been concluded as an accident. In Hong Kong, K becomes O Sir, a Physical Education teacher. His students include Ko Chun, Chloe's younger brother. He also chooses to live next door to the Ko family. 2 years later, Jovy turns up at the school as a music teacher and she is partnered with O Sir to handle Ko Chun's class. Together, they help their students with their problems including run-ins with triad members. Jovy reminds O Sir of Chloe as they share many similarities while Jovy herself starts to develop feelings for O Sir. Due to Jovy's family background which exposes her to danger, O Sir has to secretly step in to save her. But how long can O Sir keep his identity a secret? He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Tai Hang Yao
programme.desc: In 1939, during the harsh anti-Japanese war in the Taihang Mountains, Eighth Route Army soldiers were unable to care for their newborn children due to brutal battlefield conditions. Led by Wang Sanping, local village women from the Women's Rescue Association stepped up, risking their lives to raise and protect the soldiers' infants. Facing constant enemy threats, these women forged a deep bond with the military through incredible sacrifice and bravery.
