programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Thunder
programme.desc: Two half-brothers, Nam and Fire, are top racing drivers. In a racing challenge with Japanese driver Kenji, Nam causes a young racing driver to be seriously injured and is depressed. Fire stands up for Nam and decides to compete with Kenji in an illegal street car race. Who will win the race? Can Nam finally bounce back?

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr Lo has three sons, Leung, Fay and Kung; and a daughter-in-law, Eliza. While they seem like a normal family, their relationships need mending. Leung and Fay play a prank on their brother Kung on his birthday by falsely claiming that he has won the lottery. This sets off a chain reaction of funny mishaps that finally brings the family together.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street
programme.desc: Hassan is a Pakistani refugee boy whose father has died in a car accident. A local taxi driver, Yat, then helps him flee Hong Kong. In the process, the two gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the shocking truth about his father's death…

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: Struggling with Alzheimer's disease, Hong Kong film buff Kim relies on his brother to manage their appliance repair shop. Kim's quirky behaviour prompts producer Ginger to suspect that he may be a film critic trying to profit from harsh reviews. Posing as a friend, Ginger uncovers Kim's secrets and sorrows as she gets closer to him and his family.

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Zun Fei becomes the right-hand man to Macau tycoon Huang, whose hands are deep in both legal and illegal businesses. However, facing underworld violence, power struggles and moral dilemmas, Fei is torn between love and justice. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a deadly gamble set against him, with his life at stake.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost sacrifices her life to save her baby; a boy commits suicide after being bullied by four medical students and his spirit returns for revenge; some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes, releasing a more than 20-year resentment.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon “Thundering Sword” to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber(1961)
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancée suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancée accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

Dalam masa sama, Sara dan Irfan semakin bahagia, malah Irfan membantu merapatkan hubungan Sara dengan Hussin. Namun, ketika mereka kembali menikmati kebahagiaan, Irfan dikejutkan dengan berita mengejutkan daripada Tokma mengenai Fatimah yang selama ini berkelakuan pelik.

programme.title: Pendosa Ingin Ke Syurga
programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn (Abdullah) menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Izz dan Dara berpindah ke rumah baharu untuk menjauhi Ryan. Bagaimanapun, Ryan dengan licik sengaja meninggalkan telefonnya di butik Dara demi mencetuskan cemburu, menyebabkan Izz merajuk lalu menghilangkan diri. Sementara itu, Manja dipukul oleh Joe, dan Nita pula enggan menggugurkan kandungannya walaupun ditawarkan wang.

programme.title: WOK

Disangkakan malam pertama penuh bahagia, tersiksa dibalik pintu yang begitu asing bagi diri wok.

programme.desc: Dengan semangat yang masih bersisa, Aisya berusaha untuk terus kuat demi anaknya dan kerjayanya. Dia mula menulis lagu-lagu yang mencerminkan perjalanan hidupnya.

programme.title: Aku Seorang Perempuan

programme.desc: Selepas Mona dilepaskan demi menyelamatkan anaknya, Anom dirawat di pusat psikiatri dan mengawal Mona sepenuhnya. Dakwaan pembunuhan rupanya halusinasi, menimbulkan persoalan tentang kebenaran sebenar di sebalik delusi Mona.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Wok disiksa suami sendiri, disiksa batin dan fizikal kerana nafsu binatangnya. Maimun semakin teruk dan akhirnya menghembuskan nafas seorang diri di rumah. Sampai ke bandar, usop sedaya upaya menjejaki Wok. Akhirnya usop dapat bertemu dengan Deris. Wok dapat melepaskan diri, apabila Deris telah lalai kelam kabut keluar rumah tanpa mengunci mangga pintu.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP9
programme.desc: Zacky selamat setelah dirawat oleh Dr Zakir dan Dr Flora. Sementara itu Alia mula terganggu dengan Zacky dan orang-orang yang memanggil namanya Affi. Ritz masih tetap merahsiakan idenditi Alia kerana bimbang dia disakiti. Alia mula meragui idenditinya lalu bertindak untuk menyiasat. Dalam situasi berasingan, sepasukan polis giat menyiasat kes-kes lama berkaitan kehilangan dan kematian wanita yang tidak dapat dikesan. Amir menjadi suspek utama mereka

programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Sate

Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Mean Talk
programme.desc: The brand-new, unconventional talk show "Mean Talk" hosts Bob Lam and Elena Kong invite celebrity guests each episode to boldly speak the truth in the most "Mean" way. Content includes the most frustrating experiences since entering the industry, the most unbelievable entertainment secrets, the most blunt and provocative remarks, and the most scandalous programs of their film and television careers! To qualify as "Mean Talk," guests must lower their standards and be "Mean" to others. Before the interview, guests must sign a "Mean Confession Voucher," promising to reveal their true feelings, answer randomly selected questions honestly, and speak the truth anonymously!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces."

programme.title: Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: Twelve TVB artists step into the dubbing booth to re-render famous lines and high-drama scenes from classic series (such as A Kindred Spirit, Heart of Greed, and The Greed of Man). Contestants must synchronize lip movements, match exact timing, and deliver intense emotional voice performances—ranging from hysterical crying and rapid-fire arguments to comedic character impressions—competing for the title of Top Voice Performer.

programme.title: The Elites Talk
programme.desc: The Elites Talk features top business leaders and entrepreneurs sharing insights on market trends, corporate leadership, and industry growth across Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: "'You Are Not Alone' triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the 'King of Ghosts' Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of 'Spirit Connection,' with the team closely following live broadcasts,

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Man Who Kills Troubles, The
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and he wants to take care of them for her. His girlfriend was Chloe and she died in a lab explosion that has been concluded as an accident. In Hong Kong, K becomes O Sir, a Physical Education teacher. His students include Ko Chun, Chloe's younger brother. He also chooses to live next door to the Ko family. 2 years later, Jovy turns up at the school as a music teacher and she is partnered with O Sir to handle Ko Chun's class. Together, they help their students with their problems including run-ins with triad members. Jovy reminds O Sir of Chloe as they share many similarities while Jovy herself starts to develop feelings for O Sir. Due to Jovy's family background which exposes her to danger, O Sir has to secretly step in to save her. But how long can O Sir keep his identity a secret? He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she still cannot create any chemistry with him. Unexpectedly, HUNG SIN (King Kong), heir to a Taiwanese Tan-Tsu noodles business, begins to take a fancy to KWAI-FUN, and he even roughs it in the subdivided flat together with KAI-FONG and the others so as to get to know KWAI-FUN better. Since KWAI-FUN's effort goes unnoticed by PAK-YIP, she shifts her focus to court his uncle, LAU LEI-KO (Timothy Cheng). Later on, facing growing negative criticism over his girlfriend KAI-FONG, PAK-YIP cannot bear it anymore, which eventually sours his relationship with KAI-FONG. When there's no such thing as unconditional love, and the line between good and bad becomes blurred, love transforms to a predatory affair, catapulting everyone, both male and female, to the brink of war......

programme.title: Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: While being instructed to investigate some transnational crime, OCTB officers Hui Chun-sum (Ruco Chan) and Shum Wai-lik (Ben Wong) find out Ngai Chi-lok (Cheung Wing Hong), who was the culprit behind the Tiger Cull case, sent some secret message to the dark web before he was apprehended. He also made a transfer of a substantial amount in cryptocurrency. And soon some mysterious person plots to launch a terrorist attack. Although Chun-sum and Wai-lik solve the case with the help of the talented Prof Tong Kwun-fung (Alex Fong), but they are shocked to realize there is some more evil conspiracy hidden behind Chi-lok! While they just have to foil Chi-lok's scheme, they also have to deal with strange cases such as dragon head rod crisis, white bones in empty space and hardened criminal jailbreak. And are they able to clear away obstacles? While crisis escalates in the workplace, there are also challenging love issues. Chun-sum hopes to be reunited with his ex-girlfriend Ma Wing-sze (Lam Ha Mei). However, the couple's relationship is kind of iffy as they have deal with so many problems.

programme.title: Tai Hang Yao
programme.desc: In 1939, during the harsh anti-Japanese war in the Taihang Mountains, Eighth Route Army soldiers were unable to care for their newborn children due to brutal battlefield conditions. Led by Wang Sanping, local village women from the Women's Rescue Association stepped up, risking their lives to raise and protect the soldiers' infants. Facing constant enemy threats, these women forged a deep bond with the military through incredible sacrifice and bravery.

programme.desc: This show focuses on the issues that are most important to urban modern women. It combines current events with discussions of life's major and minor problems and invites various specialists to address various difficulties.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show 'Top Singers' aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers fast-paced coverage of the latest celebrity news, entertainment events and popular culture. Through studio segments, interviews, live reports and highlights, the programme keeps viewers informed about current stars, performances and industry developments.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Love Around
programme.desc: After painful breakups, Zhou Zhen and radio DJ Liang Xiaoshu find comfort in each other. Their growing bond is tested when his father responds to her criticism by deciding to buy her radio station, leaving Zhou caught between family and love.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost sacrifices her life to save her baby; a boy commits suicide after being bullied by four medical students and his spirit returns for revenge; some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes, releasing a more than 20-year resentment.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Soul Mate
programme.desc: July and An Sheng have been best friends since they were thirteen. They always believed their friendship would last forever, until they meet Su Jia Ming at the age of eighteen. The trio find themselves in a love triangle, which puts the girls' friendship to the test and alters their destinies.

programme.title: Endless Battle
programme.desc: This is a story about two brothers. The younger brother is a drug lord while the elder brother Zhong is a police officer in the Narcotics Bureau. Both are involved in a drug cartel's turf battle and during an escort mission, Zhong discovers his brother's hidden identity. This leads to an endless battle between good and evil.

programme.title: I Believe
programme.desc: Chu Chu has been waiting for her first love for 10 years but he marries someone else in the end. As she loses faith in love, she meets a wedding planner and a handsome and rich man, who both help her get over her ex-boyfriend. As Chu Chu feels the same love from them, she must make up her mind. Who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: Love is the only Answer
programme.desc: At Bo and Cheong wedding reception, the projected was initially showing their journey of love, but suddenly a flash of a clip of Cheong and a sexy girl being intimate came up. Bo calmly ran up to the stage and announced that the wedding is cancelled. The incident rapidly became a hot topic on the internet. Within a year, back to being single again, Bo and the living life happily Cheong maintains a good relationship. One day, Cheong decided to play with love and took Bo to participate in a swinging party. The conservative Bo initially wanted to leave, but after being bribed by Cheong, she helpless and stayed. At the swinging party, the two encounter Kit and his wife Man Lai. The 4 of them develop a romantic and hot relationship... At another wedding reception, when the projector plays the groom and bride's heartwarming clips, a flash of another clip that does not want to be seen comes up...

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: Z Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk is on the case of a corrupt policeman but finds all key witnesses killed when he starts to discover some clues. As investigation continues, Luk uncovers the fraud scheme of an organized corrupt group involving the government's $15 billion 'Care Fund'. He must fight against them to keep Hong Kong corruption free.

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: Locksmith Master Shan suffers from dementia and passes on his skills to Hao Ren, who surpasses him. Detective Liu often seeks Hao Ren's help and they become good friends. When Hao Ren reunites with an old friend one day, he accidentally unfolds the truth behind Shan's wife's disappearance, leading to a chain of mysterious events.

programme.title: Triad
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting (William Chan). Cheung (Derek Tsang) and Dong (Edward Chui) are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: The chief security officer at a top-secret medical facility finds himself caught in an explosive battle when a young thief steals a groundbreaking medicine. After discovering the true origins of the medicine however, the officer must decide who he can trust to protect the cure from falling into the wrong hands and prevent an all-out war.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal…

programme.title: Nilavuku En Mel Ennadi Kobam
programme.desc: A heartbroken young man agrees to an arranged marriage chosen by his parents. Just as he accepts this new path, his former love unexpectedly reenters his life, complicating matters.

programme.title: Kozhipannai Chelladurai
programme.desc: Chelladurai and Jeyasudha, siblings, face life's struggles after a devastating tragedy, their unbreakable bond fortified by their uncle Periyasamy's constant guidance since childhood.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North America's largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwich'in, one of the indigenous people of the region, call "Yu-kun- ah", or, the "great river". The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: It's November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

Ah Jie has a wide circle of acquaintances, inviting guests from different fields, including Mak Ling Ling, Nancy Sit, Laurinda Ho, Philip Keung, Alex Fong, and Chin Ka-lok, to compete for the best performance and generous prizes!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. " Cantopop At 50" invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: Twelve TVB artists step into the dubbing booth to re-render famous lines and high-drama scenes from classic series (such as A Kindred Spirit, Heart of Greed, and The Greed of Man). Contestants must synchronize lip movements, match exact timing, and deliver intense emotional voice performances—ranging from hysterical crying and rapid-fire arguments to comedic character impressions—competing for the title of Top Voice Performer.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "News Perspective" is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces."

programme.desc: The Elites Talk features top business leaders and entrepreneurs sharing insights on market trends, corporate leadership, and industry growth across Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Shaw Prize Special 2026, The & Yes, Boss.
programme.desc: Established in 2002 by media pioneer Sir Run Run Shaw, The Shaw Prize (often referred to as the "Nobel Prize of the East") honors international scientists whose groundbreaking research has advanced human civilization and knowledge.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.desc: TBC
